info.title: Tabsan EduSphere API
info.description: REST API of Tabsan EduSphere. Routes start with /api/v1/; changes within v1 are additive (new endpoints, new optional fields). Authenticate with a sign-in token (Bearer JWT) or a personal access token created on the API Tokens page (Bearer esk_…). Requests are limited per token, per user and per address (429 with Retry-After). JSON uses camelCase and omits null fields; errors return { "message": "…" }. Send Accept-Language (en, ur, ar) for translated messages.
